messages.subject: Question about longitudinal sem
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am trying to test the relation between one continuous manifest variable and one latent variable (with six indicators) over two time points. The research question is basically does this continuous observed variable (a memory process) predict accumulation of content knowledge (latent factor) over time? I used the build up approach to confirm no significant decrement in model fit from configural to weak to strong for the latent factor. 

My question is do I now add in the regression paths with the continuous manifest variable to the same strong invariance model, where factor loadings and intercepts are equated over time? Or do I run something else? 

Thank you in advance for your help!
